description: Performance sweep - C#: valkey-glide-csharp vs StackExchange.Redis (default configs), matching the Valkey GLIDE C# 1.0 GA comparison. Select the GLIDE package with bench-aws.sh --csharp-client-version (and --csharp-client-package for builds not on nuget.org); StackExchange.Redis is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/StackExchange.Redis ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise.
